scientific_findings: Candidate cap64 per case follows canonical chain/hash order and retains all overflow candidates.
Both decision stages and join/auditor code must already be sealed before candidate inventory.
Actual retained bytes are rehashed against independently authenticated range or whole-object evidence before decode.
Full transaction projections over37 study days establish candidate presence; candidate days require complete log identity/address scan and exact selected membership/count checks.
Missing hash is unavailable, not nonexistent or outside-window by inference.
Timeout closes all facts unavailable; earlier partial matches are not promoted.
Successful/failed execution status and actual identity remain separate from primary attack-role adjudication.
No-core assertion requires verified full candidate-day scan; observation-file absence alone is insufficient.
continuation_limitations: Original acceptance source-plan equality rejects a truthful changed execution plan.
Grouping every record from transport/requests.json assumes all successful; a cumulative A1+A2 ledger retaining failed A1 response requires an explicit accepted-receipt view bound to original lineage.
Use a separately reviewed continuation adapter before the post-decision study seal; preserve full failed-response ledger and original plan identity.
